about: The exact source archives of the GPL-3.0 parts of the bundled Kokoro voice. scripts/publish-release.mjs fetches each from its canonical URL at release time, checks the SHA-256 here, and attaches it to the GitHub release. espeak-ng is the tag espeakng-loader 0.2.4 builds (its CI clones espeak-ng at 1.52.0; the wheel ships libespeak-ng.1.52.0.dylib). Keep these in step with requirements.lock.
